monsters, and mutants running rampant. Ultimately, this is a disaster that could swallow the world. Hollows are not where ordinary people should go.\nSo don't go into Hollows.\nOr at least, don't go in alone.\nIf you insist on getting into danger, go to New Eridu first.\nThis city full of people from all walks of life has many who need the Hollows: powerful and wealthy tycoons, gangs who rule the streets, schemers hiding in the shadows, and ruthless officials.\nMake your preparations there, find strong allies, and most importantly...\nFind a \"Proxy.\"\nOnly they can guide people out of labyrinthian Hollows.\nGood luck.\n\nZenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse that takes place in a near future, with the world plagued by a mysterious disaster known as \"Hollows.\"\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Dual Identities, a Singular Experience\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nIn the near future, a mysterious natural disaster known as \"Hollows\" has occurred. A new kind of city has emerged in this disaster-ridden world — New Eridu. This last oasis has mastered the technology to co-exist with Hollows and is home to a whole host of chaotic, boisterous, dangerous, and very active factions. As a professional Proxy, you play a crucial role in linking the city and the Hollows. Your story awaits.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Build Your Squad and Fight Fast-Paced Battles\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nZenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse, here to provide a thrilling combat experience. Build a squad of up to three and begin your assault with Basic and Special Attacks. Dodge and Parry to neutralize your opponents' counterattacks, and when they're Stunned, unleash a powerful combo of Chain Attacks to finish them off! Remember, different opponents have different traits, and it would be prudent to use their weaknesses to your advantage.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Immerse Yourself in the Unique Style and Music\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nZenless Zone Zero has a unique visual style and design. With its carefully crafted character expressions and fluid movements, you'll easily feel immersed in the fascinating world as you embark on your own journey~ And of course, every VIP deserves their very own soundtrack, so you'll also have emotional beats full of drip to accompany you in each unforgettable moment~\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Surprise Encounters With Various Factions\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nRandom Play can't operate without videotapes, and Proxies can't operate without Agents. In New Eridu, customers from all walks will come knocking. So don't be fooled by their innocent and cute appearances, don't be afraid of those who tower over you and look dangerous, and don't turn away the fluffy ones who might shed fur all over your spotless floor. Sword Appearance: Sealed Curse\n\n*Equipping charms will strengthen Miyamoto Musashi's abilities.\n*Charms can be changed on the Equipment screen accessible in-game.\n*Sword appearances are cosmetic items that change the appearance of Miyamoto Musashi. They do not alter his performance in battle.\n*You can change sword appearances by selecting Change Appearance from the Spirit Mirror menu in-game.\n*Spirit Mirrors, Change Appearance and the Equipment screen will become unlocked separately as the game progresses.\n*Pre-purchase bonuses may be made available after launch.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **An all-new entry in the Onimusha series!**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-xx88s](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-xx88s.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nFight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-period Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.\nWith every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.\nFollow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.\nThrough gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **The Protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-12tsr](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-12tsr.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nAn ardent samurai who arrives in Kyoto looking to prove that he is unmatched in the way of the sword. However, the path before him takes a strange and unexpected turn.\n\nThe protagonist of this game is a fierce young samurai, constantly moving from one bloody and gritty fight to the next. To cement this image of a striking samurai, Capcom has turned to none other than the late, iconic Japanese samurai movie legend Toshiro Mifune to star as the face model for this rendition of Miyamoto Musashi.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Action**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-17r02](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-17r02.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nEquipped with an Oni Gauntlet, Musashi is granted power beyond human limits. Besides giving him the strength needed to cut down the Genma, it also holds numerous other abilities, such as being able to absorb Genma souls and convert them into a power source to further enhance its wearer. But who is behind the voice that rings out from the gauntlet?\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Genma**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-lmiv7](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-lmiv7.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nUsually found dwelling in the lowest depths of hell, the Malice enveloping Kyoto has brought these fiends into the world of the living. Their ceaseless atrocities have plunged the capital into a state of dread and panic.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Formidable Foes**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-q7sti](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-q7sti.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nIn his battle against the Genma threat, Musashi will face powerful opponents whose martial prowess rivals his own. Will he triumph, or die trying? Bloody duels to the death await in the capital.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Setting**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-dn8fp](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-dn8fp.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nThe game is set in Kyoto, home to countless shrines and temples, such as Kiyomizu-dera Temple. monsters, and mutants running rampant. Ultimately, this is a disaster that could swallow the world. Hollows are not where ordinary people should go.\nSo don't go into Hollows.\nOr at least, don't go in alone.\nIf you insist on getting into danger, go to New Eridu first.\nThis city full of people from all walks of life has many who need the Hollows: powerful and wealthy tycoons, gangs who rule the streets, schemers hiding in the shadows, and ruthless officials.\nMake your preparations there, find strong allies, and most importantly...\nFind a \"Proxy.\"\nOnly they can guide people out of labyrinthian Hollows.\nGood luck.\n\nZenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse that takes place in a near future, with the world plagued by a mysterious disaster known as \"Hollows.\"\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Dual Identities, a Singular Experience\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nIn the near future, a mysterious natural disaster known as \"Hollows\" has occurred. A new kind of city has emerged in this disaster-ridden world — New Eridu. This last oasis has mastered the technology to co-exist with Hollows and is home to a whole host of chaotic, boisterous, dangerous, and very active factions. As a professional Proxy, you play a crucial role in linking the city and the Hollows. Your story awaits.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Build Your Squad and Fight Fast-Paced Battles\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nZenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse, here to provide a thrilling combat experience. Build a squad of up to three and begin your assault with Basic and Special Attacks. Dodge and Parry to neutralize your opponents' counterattacks, and when they're Stunned, unleash a powerful combo of Chain Attacks to finish them off! Remember, different opponents have different traits, and it would be prudent to use their weaknesses to your advantage.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Immerse Yourself in the Unique Style and Music\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nZenless Zone Zero has a unique visual style and design. With its carefully crafted character expressions and fluid movements, you'll easily feel immersed in the fascinating world as you embark on your own journey~ And of course, every VIP deserves their very own soundtrack, so you'll also have emotional beats full of drip to accompany you in each unforgettable moment~\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--title--\u003E\n# Surprise Encounters With Various Factions\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nRandom Play can't operate without videotapes, and Proxies can't operate without Agents. In New Eridu, customers from all walks will come knocking. So don't be fooled by their innocent and cute appearances, don't be afraid of those who tower over you and look dangerous, and don't turn away the fluffy ones who might shed fur all over your spotless floor. 【Pre-purchase Bonus】\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nA set containing a charm and a sword appearance that can be used in-game.\n\n1. Charm: Lion Dog\n2. Sword Appearance: Sealed Curse\n\n*Equipping charms will strengthen Miyamoto Musashi's abilities.\n*Charms can be changed on the Equipment screen accessible in-game.\n*Sword appearances are cosmetic items that change the appearance of Miyamoto Musashi. They do not alter his performance in battle.\n*You can change sword appearances by selecting Change Appearance from the Spirit Mirror menu in-game.\n*Spirit Mirrors, Change Appearance and the Equipment screen will become unlocked separately as the game progresses.\n*Pre-purchase bonuses may be made available after launch.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **An all-new entry in the Onimusha series!**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-xx88s](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-xx88s.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nFight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-period Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.\nWith every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.\nFollow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.\nThrough gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **The Protagonist, Miyamoto Musashi**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-12tsr](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-12tsr.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nAn ardent samurai who arrives in Kyoto looking to prove that he is unmatched in the way of the sword. However, the path before him takes a strange and unexpected turn.\n\nThe protagonist of this game is a fierce young samurai, constantly moving from one bloody and gritty fight to the next. To cement this image of a striking samurai, Capcom has turned to none other than the late, iconic Japanese samurai movie legend Toshiro Mifune to star as the face model for this rendition of Miyamoto Musashi.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Action**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-17r02](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-17r02.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nEquipped with an Oni Gauntlet, Musashi is granted power beyond human limits. Besides giving him the strength needed to cut down the Genma, it also holds numerous other abilities, such as being able to absorb Genma souls and convert them into a power source to further enhance its wearer. But who is behind the voice that rings out from the gauntlet?\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Genma**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-lmiv7](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-lmiv7.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nUsually found dwelling in the lowest depths of hell, the Malice enveloping Kyoto has brought these fiends into the world of the living. Their ceaseless atrocities have plunged the capital into a state of dread and panic.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Formidable Foes**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-q7sti](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-q7sti.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nIn his battle against the Genma threat, Musashi will face powerful opponents whose martial prowess rivals his own. Will he triumph, or die trying? Bloody duels to the death await in the capital.\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\n### **Setting**\n\n\u003C!--image--\u003E\n![Onimusha: Way of the Sword-dn8fp](https:\u002F\u002Fcdn1.epicgames.com\u002Fspt-assets\u002F9df6866227c144dfb0605b07e1d1ef31\u002Fonimusha-way-of-the-sword-dn8fp.jpg)\n\n\u003C!--textBlock--\u003E\n\u003C!--text--\u003E\nThe game is set in Kyoto, home to countless shrines and temples, such as Kiyomizu-dera Temple. Markdown","title":"EA Play FAQ","content":"# EA Play gives you unlimited access to a collection of Electronic Arts titles, trials of select new EA games, monthly rewards & more.\n\n# What games do I get with EA Play?\n\nYou get unlimited access to a growing library of EA’s top titles including Battlefield™ 2042, EA SPORTS™ F1® 24, EA SPORTS™ FC 24, EA SPORTS™ Madden NFL 24, STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor™, plus many more.\n\n# Do I get to keep playing the games after the trial period?\n\nOnce your trial is complete you’ll need to purchase the game if you’d like to continue playing.\n\n# If I play an EA Play game trial will my progress carry over?\n\nEA Play members can download and try the latest EA games for a limited time. Yep – your progress will carry over, so you can pick up where you left off if you decide to purchase the game.\n\n# Is EA Play available on other platforms?\n\nYes! EA Play is available for PC via the Epic Games Store, the EA app and Steam. It is also available on Xbox and PlayStation®. Please note: while EA Play is available on multiple platforms your membership is tied to the platform you joined on. If you joined on the Epic Games Store, your Play List, member discount, and all other benefits will only be available here.\n\n# What payment methods can I use to purchase an EA Play membership?\n\nDepending on where you live, you can use a credit card or PayPal. Not all methods are available everywhere.\n\n# How do I join EA Play?\n\nSimple - all you got to do is sign up. Just follow the on-screen instructions and you'll be knee-deep in games in no time.\n\n# What's The Play List?\n\nThe Play List is a collection of incredible games featuring new hits, fan-favorites, and so much more included in your membership. All full versions for you to play as much as you want. Find out more here.\n\n# Why do games on The Play List vary from country to country?\n\nShort answer: different countries have different rules about what games can be sold or made available. The result: what you see in The Play List may vary slightly by locale.\n\n# Where do I go to download games and trials?\n\nTo download a game or trial, head to the Included Games section on the main EA Play page. Then, simply choose the game or trial you want to play.\n\n# What can I use my member discount on?\n\nAs an EA Play member, you'll score an automatic 10% discount on EA digital purchases from the Epic Games Store, including new releases and pre-orders. Ditto for expansions, game packs, points, you name it. Please note: while EA Play is available on multiple platforms your discount only applies to the platform you joined on. For example, if you joined via the Epic Games Store, your EA digital purchases here would receive a 10% discount. If you joined on Xbox, your EA digital purchases on Xbox would receive the 10% discount.\n\n# Can I play EA Play games on Mac?\n\nEA Play is not available on Mac.\n\n# How do I cancel my EA Play membership?\n\nCanceling your EA Play membership is quick and easy. Just log into your Epic Games Store account to cancel. \n\n# What if I want to cancel EA Play before my membership ends?\n\nIf you cancel your membership prior to your next monthly or annual billing date, you won't be charged for the following month or year. You'll be able to continue to play games, use your discount and jump into any available trials until your membership expires.\n\n# I am experiencing a technical issue. Where can I go for help?\n\nWe're sorry for the inconvenience. You can find solutions to common issues As Shadow gains new powers, he can explore further and uncover the secrets hidden throughout!\n\n# An Epic Time-Traveling Sonic Adventure\n\nPast meets present in SONIC GENERATIONS! collection of 3D and 2D versions of iconic stages from past Sonic games, now with updated visuals and reworked cinematics. \n\n# More Collectibles, Bonus Content, and more!\n\nRescue Chao hiding in
